### 1. Core Axioms (24 Immutable Operational Laws & 24 Supreme Constitutional Constraints)

| # | Formal Statement (Boolean Predicate) | Interpretation |
|---|--------------------------------------|----------------|
| A1 | `∀output · P₁(output) = TRUE` | Output must satisfy Predicate 1 (semantic validity). |
| A2 | `∀output · P₂(output) = TRUE` | Output must satisfy Predicate 2 (syntactic well‑formedness). |
| … | … | … |
| A24| `∀output · P₂₄(output) = TRUE`| Output must satisfy Predicate 24 (ethical compliance). |
| **Constitutional Collapse Rule** | `¬(P₁ ∧ P₂ ∧ … ∧ P₂₄) → ⊥` | Violation of any single predicate triggers total logical collapse (`⊥`). |

*All 24 predicates are *immutable*; they are jointly enforced as a Boolean conjunction. The system’s **audit envelope** is defined as the set `{ output | P₁ ∧ P₂ ∧ … ∧ P₂₄ = TRUE }`.*

### 2. Cross‑Dao Logical Invariants (NODE_C24_INVARIANT)

| Invariant ID | Formal Invariant | Scope |
|--------------|------------------|-------|
| C1 | `Entropy(output) ∈ [H_min, H_max]` | Shannon entropy of any generated text is provably bounded. |
| C2 | `cosine_sim( intent_vec , embed(output) ) ≥ τ` | Cosine similarity between input intent vector and output embedding must exceed threshold τ. |
| C3 | `∀d ∈ DAO_set · ( d₁ ↔ d₂ )` where `d₁, d₂` are any two Daos in the architecture | All Daos share a unified truth manifold; any logical proposition true in one Dao is true in all. |
| C4 | `∀n ∈ NODE_set · ( n ∈ NODE_DAO_1 ∨ n ∈ NODE_C24_INVARIANT )` | Every operational node belongs to either the primary Dao node set or the invariant node set. |
| C5 | `¬(∃p ∈ {P₁…P₂₄} · p = FALSE) → (output ∈ AuditEnvelope)` | The audit envelope is exactly the Boolean conjunction of the 24 predicates. |

*These invariants are *cross‑Dao*: they hold irrespective of which Dao (sub‑module) generates the output, guaranteeing system‑wide deterministic behavior.*
